title: Optimal refresh for materialized lake view updates and deletes (Preview)

content.text: Optimal refresh for updates and deletes lets materialized lake views process changed and deleted source rows incrementally. Refresh hints identify unique rows so Fabric can avoid a full refresh when supported source data changes.
